verdict.rationale: Zulip has no evidenced native no-code workflow builder. Its automation paths are custom bots you write and run yourself, which is code rather than no-code, plus incoming webhooks and third-party automation through Zapier and IFTTT. That makes it at best an external, extra-tool workaround rather than workflows built inside the chat tool. Missing for 10: a native in-app no-code workflow builder, schedule-based triggers, form-submission triggers, and admin-facing workflow configuration docs.
